% Source: TeX Live 2025 bchart manual, bchart.tex (font-style and scale examples).
\documentclass[varwidth=true, border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{bchart}

\begin{document}
\renewcommand{\bcfontstyle}{\bfseries}
\begin{bchart}[max=10,step=2,scale=.7]
  \bcbar[text=Bold]{7.5}
  \bcxlabel{score}
\end{bchart}
\end{document}
